payload.description:
As a household member, I want a waiting turn to keep the exact computer tool request, so that a later computer-capable attempt can execute that call instead of inventing a new one.

Feature: Turn-scoped server-sent events

Scenario: A waiting turn exposes its pending computer tool over HTTP
  Given an empty control plane
  And tenant anthus user ryan has a channel with a named bot Researcher
  And user ryan of tenant anthus has an active turn on the channel
  When the worker posts a progress chunk and then waits on the browser gate
  Then user ryan can read the pending computer tool request_computer_capability for browser

Not included: starting Fargate, executing the tool, staging or production deploy.
payload.title: A waiting turn records the pending computer tool
